title: The roof on television
lede: Two commercials from the years when the chain was growing, and four pieces of reporting from the years when it was down to its last restaurants.

videos.title: Howard Johnson’s television commercial
videos.caption: A 29-second spot selling the orange roof and the 28 flavors to families on the road. The year 1962 comes only from the uploader.[^31]

videos.title: Animated commercial for children’s parties
videos.caption: An animated one-minute ad inviting children to hold their parties at the restaurant. The year 1970 comes only from the uploader, a commercial-archive channel.[^31]

videos.title: CBS Sunday Morning: “The last Howard Johnson’s restaurant”
videos.caption: Published July 12, 2015. Kristine Johnson visits Lake George, a few months after it reopened and after Lake Placid closed. Bangor was still open at the time.[^28]

videos.title: BBC News: “The last Howard Johnson’s”
videos.caption: Published August 31, 2017. A BBC reporter who shares the founder’s name visits the Lake George restaurant and asks what went wrong.[^29]

videos.title: WNYT: “Last Howard Johnson’s restaurant in America closes”
videos.caption: Published June 2, 2022 by the Albany NBC affiliate: the local report on the closing of the Lake George restaurant.[^15]

videos.title: A history of Howard Johnson’s, with Anthony Sammarco
videos.caption: Published June 1, 2021. An hour-long podcast interview with the Boston historian who wrote a book-length history of the chain. Useful background; we did not use it as a source for figures.

note: Upload titles and dates on video platforms are often wrong. The two commercials are dated by their uploaders only.
